## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
ROTATION. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: (1) Technology and Materials are driving the move with large semiconductor 1W gains, (2) Financials, Energy and Communication lag, indicating money is rotating rather than fleeing.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Technology lead: QCOM (1W: +41.07% | 1M: +85.48%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +35.14% | 1M: +107.50%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +34.33% | 1M: +87.23%) ABOVE TREND. Materials/industrial strength: FCX (1W: +15.84% | 1M: -4.85%) RECOVERY, CAT (1W: +5.95% | 1M: +17.44%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Energy weak: XOM (1W: -2.61% | 1M: -1.86%) BELOW TREND, COP (1W: -7.49% | 1M: -5.71%) BELOW TREND. Communication and Financials lag: CMCSA (1W: -7.54% | 1M: -10.38%) BELOW TREND, JPM (1W: -2.49% | 1M: -3.19%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: QCOM (1W: +41.07% | 1M: +85.48%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +35.14% | 1M: +107.50%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +34.33% | 1M: +87.23%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +15.84% | 1M: -4.85%) RECOVERY, PANW (1W: +15.77% | 1M: +37.20%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology) — concentration risk flagged.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: SHOP (1W: -19.61% | 1M: -7.45%) BELOW TREND, CHTR (1W: -10.61% | 1M: -32.46%) BELOW TREND, PYPL (1W: -10.56% | 1M: -0.38%) BELOW TREND, OXY (1W: -8.51% | 1M: -4.88%) BELOW TREND, COP (1W: -7.49% | 1M: -5.71%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in Communication, Energy and select Payments names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Top 1W movers: QCOM (1W: +41.07%), INTC (1W: +35.14%), AMD (1W: +34.33%), PANW (1W: +15.77%), FCX (1W: +15.84%). Major divergence: MSFT (1W: -0.23% | 1M: +11.27%) CORRECTION, AMZN (1W: -1.12% | 1M: +12.84%) CORRECTION, V (1W: -0.91% | 1M: +6.41%) CORRECTION — multi-cap divergence; watch for trend breaks.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Technology mixed but leading on semiconductors and AI-tools names: NVDA (1W: +10.56% | 1M: +16.33%) ABOVE TREND, AAPL (1W: +5.82% | 1M: +12.47%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +13.35% | 1M: +11.05%) ABOVE TREND. Sector performance: Technology up 1W +6.79% (part of the 6/11 positive sectors).

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials lag on the week and show dispersion: JPM (1W: -2.49% | 1M: -3.19%) BELOW TREND, PYPL (1W: -10.56% | 1M: -0.38%) BELOW TREND, V (1W: -0.91% | 1M: +6.41%) CORRECTION. Sector performance: Financials negative this week and part of the 5/11 lagging sectors.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare mixed with select strength amid earnings: UNH (1W: +3.69% | 1M: +26.32%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: -1.24% | 1M: -7.14%) BELOW TREND, ISRG (1W: -7.14% | 1M: -6.78%) BELOW TREND — sector down 1W; watch UNH as the primary leader.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor Technology and select Industrials where momentum is clear (QCOM, AMD, AMAT, CAT) and reduce exposure to lagging Communication and Energy names (CMCSA, CHTR, COP). Style: Growth/Momentum favored given semiconductor leadership, but narrow top-heavy leadership argues for selectivity and position sizing.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: QCOM (1W: +41.07% | 1M: +85.48%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +35.14% | 1M: +107.50%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +3.69% | 1M: +26.32%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: SHOP (1W: -19.61% | 1M: -7.45%) BELOW TREND, CHTR (1W: -10.61% | 1M: -32.46%) BELOW TREND, PYPL (1W: -10.56% | 1M: -0.38%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Technology (1W +6.79%, part of the 6/11 positives) and Materials. BEARISH: Communication and Energy (both negative 1W); Financials remain mixed and warrant monitoring.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
NVDA (ABOVE TREND): watch follow-through above recent swing highs for momentum extension; AAPL (ABOVE TREND): monitor consolidation hold near recent breakout area for continuation; QCOM/INTC/AMD: continued 1W outperformance vs. semicap ETF flows will validate rotation; SHOP/CHTR: failure to stabilize weekly lows would signal deeper downside.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
UNH (+80): UnitedHealth earnings/guide lift; UNH (1W: +3.69% | 1M: +26.32%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed. MNST (+65): Monster record Q1; MNST (1W: +14.91% | 1M: +14.12%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed. CAT (+60): strong Q1 and data-center deal; CAT (1W: +5.95% | 1M: +17.44%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed. AMAT (+60): AI tools alliance; AMAT (1W: +13.35% | 1M: +11.05%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed. JNJ (+60): positive trial data; JNJ (1W: -1.24% | 1M: -7.14%) BELOW TREND — sentiment/divergence to watch.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
META (-45): legal/operational headlines; META (1W: -1.89% | 1M: -4.92%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirming weakness. (Fewer SP100 names with public 1W/1M in the bearish list are available in the dataset; monitor other names flagged in news for follow-through.)

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

ROTATION with a Growth/Momentum tilt as semiconductors and AI tools lead while Financials and Communications lag. QCOM, INTC, AMD, NVDA (all ABOVE TREND) are showing relative strength while SHOP, CHTR, PYPL (all BELOW TREND) show material weakness. Key risk: narrow leadership (4/5 top performers from Technology) and multi-cap divergences (MSFT/AMZN/V in CORRECTION) — watch for trend breaks and news-confirmed follow-through.
